claude.sample_unit: patients with chart review (of 1000 patients in EHR sample)

links.outcome: Clinician adjudication of LLM-proposed search terms for clinical relevance
links.effect: Of 514 LLM (context) ICD-10 codes matching sample patients, at least 1 clinician endorsed 421 (82%); exclusions included clinically irrelevant additions like pulmonary hypertension; final roadmap recovered 73 (18%) vs 83 (20%) unadjudicated.
links.quote: Of the 514 ICD-10 codes matching patients in our sample based on LLMs (context), at least 1 clinician endorsed 421 of them ( 82 % ).

links.outcome: Clinician validation of LLM-generated clinical knowledge (search terms) before use
links.effect: Clinicians removed 18% of LLM (context) matched codes not clinically relevant; the clinician-approved roadmap recovered 73 (18%) missing values vs 83-89 (20-22%) for unreviewed LLM roadmaps.
links.quote: Large language models (context + clinicians) recovered more than the experts but less than the LLMs alone (73, 18 % ), suggesting that the enhancements successfully broadened the search terms but not all were clinically relevant.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs with clinician adjudication to expand clinical search-term roadmaps for EHR missing data recovery
Self-consistency prompting across 20 independent LLM chats to generate exhaustive term lists

links.effect: Unique ICD-10 code matches from repeated LLM runs plateaued after about 10 iterations.
links.quote: Across the loop, the number of unique ICD-10 codes matching the proposed search terms (taken as the superset of all those proposed thus far) seemed to plateau after about 10 iterations ( Supplemental Figure S2 ).

links.effect: LLM-enhanced roadmaps recommended 83-89 (20%-22%) versus expert chart reviews 49 (12%).
links.quote: The expert chart reviews recovered 49 (12%), while the algorithms using LLMs-enhanced roadmaps recommended almost twice as many (83-89, 20%-22%).

links.effect: Clinicians endorsed 421 of 514 (82%) LLM-context ICD-10 code matches.
links.quote: Of the 514 ICD-10 codes matching patients in our sample based on LLMs (context), at least 1 clinician endorsed 421 of them ( 82 % ).

links.effect: 4009 ALI components were missing; 789 (20%) were recovered by the algorithm.
links.quote: Of 4009 missing ALI components, 789 ( 20 % ) were recovered.
